outcome.technical: BUILT (1): plugins/audit/scripts/status/_status_facts.py gains FLOOR_KINDS and floor_readings(phase, read_executor) beside intent_unanswered, with one helper _floor_kind. For the phase's DONE tasks only it returns four lists of ids - findings, notCompared (answer clean, notRead non-empty), couldNotTell, notMeasured (no return, no block, an unmarked block, a return that is not an object) - a plain clean task in none, a findings task under findings alone. The block is read ONLY through _fr.floor_block (fl8 pins that the two functions call it and spell no field of the return). The module still opens nothing: the reader is the caller's. BUILT (2): audit-status.py gains _executor_reader, floor_readings_block, FLOOR_LINE_WORDS and _floor_lines. The reader is _fr.read_filed_return_checked(_fr.return_path(evidence_dir, task, 'executor'), journal rows, project) - the CHECKED read, which plain_read_violations allows anywhere, so no exemption row was needed (plain_read_violations() returns [] after the change); a journal that cannot be read leaves the read unchecked as a close's does, and any raise in the per-task read is no reading (not measured). floor_readings_block reads only phases whose rollup entry has signoffDue, and is injected into the summary for the human render alone (beside keptTrees in main), so --json is unchanged. _floor_lines prints under the 'no intent answer' line, inside the same signoffDue branch, one line per non-empty kind: 'floor guard, moves found: <ids>', 'floor guard, files not compared: <ids>', 'floor guard, could not tell: <ids>', 'floor guard, not measured: <ids>'. Two lines beyond the brief, each so a missing reading is never printed as 'not measured' or as nothing: a due phase whose row was read from another copy (rollup copy.read) prints 'floor guard, not read here: this phase was read from <copy>, and its returns are filed there' instead of reading this checkout's returns, and an evidence directory that cannot be resolved prints 'floor guard, not read: <why>'.
